traits.name: Aura of the Unremembered
traits.description: The King radiates drifting grey ash in a 20ft radius. The area is lightly obscured, creatures other than the King have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks inside it. Any creature that enters the aura for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Impossible Anatomy
traits.description: The King can move through the space of other creatures. First time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature must make DC 18 Dexterity save or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The King cannot end its turn inside another creature.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If the King fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Phase II - The Eye Opens
traits.description: When the King is reduced to 100 HP, every creature within 30ft must make DC 17 Wisdom save: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and frightened until end of next turn on failure, half damage on success. Then the King gains: Second Movement - can teleport up to 30ft as bonus action; Eye of the Void - Void Lance deals 22 (4d10) psychic; Nightmare Pulse - at start of each of its turns, one random creature within 60ft takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The King makes two Ruin Claw attacks and one Void Lance attack.

actions.name: Ruin Claw
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +11 to hit, reach 10ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) slashing plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Void Lance
actions.description: Ranged spell attack: +9 to hit, range 90ft, one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage and target must succeed on DC 17 Wisdom save or cannot take reactions until start of its next turn. After Phase II: 22 (4d10) psychic.

actions.name: Collapse Reality
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6) Choose point within 90ft. Each creature in 20ft-radius sphere must make DC 18 Dexterity save: 27 (6d8) force damage and knocked prone on failure, half damage and not prone on success. Area becomes unstable until end of encounter: movement costs double, teleportation into/out of it fails, creatures standing there have disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The King moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Ruin Claw
legendary_actions.description: Costs 2 Actions. The King makes one Ruin Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Tear Open
legendary_actions.description: Costs 2 Actions. The King makes one Void Lance attack.

monsterData.description: Enormous humanoid turned living ruin of black stone and corpse-grey flesh. Broken pillars from back, long black tendrils, featureless face except single cyan eye with concentric markings. Telepathic: 'You remember me.'

traits.name: Necrotic Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the Vexilla is subjected to necrotic damage, it takes no damage and instead regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: Floating Mass
traits.description: The Vexilla is immune to the prone condition and ignores difficult terrain while hovering. Speed 0 ft., fly 40 ft. (hover).

traits.name: Warped Senses
traits.description: The Vexilla has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while in vibrant light or clear air outside the standard heavy fog.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Vexilla makes two Tar Slam attacks and, if available, uses Spore Expulsion.

actions.name: Tar Slam
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 15ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Spore Expulsion
actions.description: (Recharge 5-6) The Vexilla expels a 30-foot cone of necrotic spores. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

monsterData.description: Huge Aberration (Cursed), floating mass of tar and spores.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Long jump up to 30 ft., high jump up to 15 ft., with or without running start.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: Two attacks: one with bite and one with claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.description: If leaps 15+ ft. and lands next to target, DC 14 STR save or knocked prone + 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Ashen Acclimation
traits.description: The mercenary can see through fog or heavy ash up to 120 feet, allowing them to spot threats before they emerge.

traits.name: Branding Precision
traits.description: Once per turn, when the mercenary hits a creature with a melee weapon attack, it can apply the Brand Mark. A branded creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against the mercenary until the start of the mercenary's next turn.

traits.name: Iron Grip (Slave-Hunter)
traits.description: While a creature is grappled by the mercenary, that creature is also restrained, and the mercenary has advantage on attacks against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mercenary makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Heavy Spiked Maul - Slaver's Weaponry (The Mauler)
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Instant Thermal Activation - Brander's Gauntlet (The Iron Hand)
actions.description: The mercenary activates the heating elements in its left gauntlet, which begins to pulse with the Dull Crimson glow. For 1 minute, the gauntlet is considered a magical weapon. Once per round, when the mercenary makes a successful Unarmed Strike with the gauntlet, it deals an additional 9 (2d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Branding Fist (Unarmed Strike)
actions.description: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) bludgeoning damage. If Instant Thermal Activation is active, add 9 (2d8) fire damage. If the target is grappled, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of its next turn.

monsterData.description: Medium Humanoid (Ash Elf), Lawful Evil. Mercenaries of Iron-Grip are brutal, disciplined warriors. Their combat styles are a calculated mix of a slaver's cruel efficiency and a brute's power, using customized spiked iron weaponry and the terrifying Brander's Gauntlet to break not just flesh, but will.
